# Zephyr Technology
> UK shop to buy new and used phones and to sell your old phone. Genuine, checked devices, fast UK delivery and secure checkout.

## Main pages
- [Buy phones](https://www.zephyrtechnology.co.uk/): all phones for sale, with live price and stock
- [New phones](https://www.zephyrtechnology.co.uk/phones/new): new iPhones and phones
- [Used phones](https://www.zephyrtechnology.co.uk/phones/used): professionally checked used phones
- [Sell your phone](https://www.zephyrtechnology.co.uk/sell-your-phone): choose your model and get a quote
